title: The Seven Invariants: A Placement Guide for Coherent Systems
description:
The Seven Variants exists to resolve classification friction.
It does not introduce new invariants or claims. It explains how the same invariant structure appears differently depending on context, role, scale, and perspective.
This project helps readers place the work correctly—before interpretation, critique, or application—by separating what varies from what must not.
